The named sites each generate over 11 million cubic feet a day, already collect most of it, and put none of it to use. They are the cheapest harvest in the country.
Open sites use 30% of what they generate, closed sites 15%. A closed landfill keeps generating for decades and has less reason to have built an offtake.
Generation is modelled, not measured: the field says "Estimated" and waste-in-place alone explains 75% of it. The flared-against-used split is reported; the escape share is EPA's model.
